{{Top|leg}}
The '''MGI-A proton torpedo''' was an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] classification for a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] that was unaffected by [[Force field/Legends|energy fields]], thus allowing the weapon to penetrate most [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].
